title: plastic bathroom garbage can
text: plastic bathroom garbage can. I purchased the "metallic white" can - it's not sparkly or metallic - it's sort of frosty (?") looking.  It's not a bright white, but a bit brighter than a soft white.  It's smaller, standing about 14 to 16" tall eyeballing it.  The lid is weighted in the center of the lid, so it swings and closes as you use it.  I line it with the clear, smaller plastic liners and they fit nicely.  It's not the highest quality bin I've ever purchased, but not the worst.  I like it.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Umbra Twirla, 2.4 Gallon Trash Can with Swing-top Lid, Gray
features: WEIGHTED SWING-TOP LID: TWIRLA features a hassle-free weighted swing-top lid that flips back into place quickly and easily, just drop trash through the swing top and go
SIMPLE, CLEAN DESIGN: TWIRLA Trash Can has a simple yet effective design that looks great with any decor. The swing-top lid keeps garbage out of sight.
GREAT FOR SMALL SPACES: TWIRLA is a stylish trash can with a modern, slim design that looks great, and easily fits into narrow openings and odd spaces in your bathroom, bedroom, office, and more
DURABLE AND EASY TO MAINTAIN: Made of durable polypropylene that is stable and easy to maintain, just wipe this can clean with a damp cloth

description: Introducing Twirla Trash Can by Umbra Style meets function with this slim, easy-to-use garbage can that looks great. With a hassle-free weighted swing-top lid, Twirla keeps your waste out of sight and out of mind. Twirla can is constructed of durable polypropylene so It's sturdy and stable which means you do not have to worry about it toppling over. At the same time, It's easy to maintain - just wipe it clean with a damp cloth. Its special, weighted, swing-top lid flips back into place quickly and easily making a one-handed operation simple. Twirla is a stylish swing-top can with a modern design that looks great and fits into narrow openings and odd spaces in your home. It's especially useful as a bathroom can, but can be used anywhere in your home like an office, powder room, bedroom and more. Twirla Trash Can comes in two finishes and is 10 x 8 x 14 inches, with a 2.4gal (9L) capacity. This small receptacle works with the most popular 3-gallon or 4-gallon garbage bags, including draw-sting and flap-tie bags. This waste basket makes a great modern office garbage can, home office wastebasket, office recycling container and can easily serve as a recycling trash can. About Umbra: A global product design company providing original, modern, casual, functional, and affordable design for the home.
